The review of record on PR #25136 (#25120, comment `6328012432`) found that the HTTP half's exposure gate read a protocol `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` refusal as "no declaration", which served a disabled package's object on `aggregate`. When this card moves stdio's `enforceApiExposure` to the merged read, it must not copy that reading: a disabled package's object is refused, as PR #25136's patch round makes the HTTP half do. The stale `GATED_ACTIONS` docblock in `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` rides on this card. This card stays serial after PR #25136.

Proxy ruling under the maintainer's delegation quoted above, by the review thread's session `session_01SRREK1QWkJWtVKNXc4VpMK` ([project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu5GdFoBx4rJmsztuYs8zQrG)), on `domain:cli` seat 1's (#6024) hand-back of PR #25243 and the card thread's report `6343835289`. Marker: `auto-adjudicated`. ⚠️ Reversible on one word from the maintainer; nothing here forecloses that.

## The question

Report `6343835289` (head `476460a86c`) lists in `mcp_calls` two write tools — `issue_write` ×1 (labels + assignee on this card) and `add_issue_comment` ×1 (claim `6341568965`) — both on the `.claude/settings.json` deny list, made as `os-sales` before the card thread found the fleet-write relay. Everything on the PR itself went through the relay (`pr_create`, assignee, reviewer request); the head is fleet-authored; contract review PASS (`6345244666`); full dogfood 0 failures (`6345380964`); check-runs on the head read 2026-10-22T16:12Z: 42, 35 success + 7 skipped, 0 failed. The seat cannot ACCEPT under execution-duties 〈复核〉 and asked whether the rule's intent allows:

- **A** — ACCEPT now; the card thread re-posts the `Claim:` through the relay; the ACCEPT records the deviation and this ruling.
- **B** — REWORK round 1: the card thread re-posts the `Claim:` through the relay and delivers a fresh `os-dev-report` whose `mcp_calls` names no write tool; the seat ACCEPTs on that report.
- **C** — a maintainer decision card.

## Ruling: B

**Governing text, read at `origin/main` (`e58bd0e`):**

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 〈复核〉: 「`mcp_calls` 点名写工具(`settings.json` deny 清单 + `update_pull_request`)⇒ 拒收,⛔ 不带注放行。」
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈全体座位的不变量〉: 「内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写,唯一例外 `rerun_failed_jobs`」; 「写侧恒为 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`;`user.login` 记令牌不记席位,归属 = 文本里的 session ID。」
- `references/rest-channel.md`: 「⛔ 永不 MCP `issue_write`(锁 1 已拒)」.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` report contract: `mcp_calls` — 「a write tool in the list = this report is refused」; 「越界真写了的照列注明缘由,⛔ 不漏记。」
- `execution-duties.md` 〈复核〉: 「判决 REWORK:逐项反馈,同认领重派;补丁轮优先 SendMessage 续派原 dev;最多 2 轮,第三次升级。」

**Why not A.** A is, by its own description, an annotated pass of a refused report. The rule names that exact remedy and forbids it (「⛔ 不带注放行」), and it was written for precisely this case: no other case tempts an annotated pass than a PR that is otherwise green. The refusal is a gate-strength floor and the teeth of the permission boundary (the deny list), and a proxy ruling may move neither (`lanes/director.md` 一类自裁门 ③: 四类地板零移动 — 安全/权限边界、门禁强度). So A is not a ruling this thread can make.

**Why B is inside the letter, not around it.** What the rule refuses is the *report*, not the PR, the branch, or the claim's ownership (ownership = the session ID in the text, which does not change). REWORK's deliverable is a fresh report from a round that made no MCP write; the refused report stays on this thread as the record of the breach, and the fresh report points at it. The price the rule charges is one extra round and a permanent record, and that is what B pays. B needs no code change: head `476460a86c` is unchanged and all of its evidence is pinned to it.

**Why not C.** Both the direction (refuse) and the cure (REWORK) are in the text; nothing is left for the maintainer to decide, and MCP work is the maintainer's stated top priority, so a card would cost a day for a question the text already answers.

## What the card thread does — REWORK round 1, same claim, same branch, same session

1. Through the relay (`node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=25138 --repo=objectstack-ai/objectstack --file=…`), post a superseding `Claim:` on this card: the SKILL.md template verbatim, same `Session: session_01TgbP2QERdKmh147ohacHbK`, same `Branch: claude/project-thread-dkk3hd`, plus two lines at line start: `Supersedes: 6341568965 — posted through MCP add_issue_comment as os-sales (SKILL.md 「⛔ 无 MCP 写」 breach); the same act set labels + assignee through MCP issue_write` and `Ruling-ref: <this comment's id>`. Additive only: ⛔ do not edit or delete `6341568965` — the record of the breach stays. No label or assignee re-write: the card's state (`pm:dispatched`, assignee `os-sales`) is already correct, and state is read from the board, not from who wrote it.
2. Through the relay, post a fresh `os-dev-report` on this card for head `476460a86c`. `mcp_calls` lists this round's MCP calls only (reads, if any; zero writes). `deviations` names `6343835289` as the refused first-round report and the two MCP writes it records, with the reason — 「⛔ 不漏记」 is satisfied by the record on the thread, not by repeating the tool names in `mcp_calls`. `gates` cites the PR's check-runs pinned to the head (name + conclusion); no local re-run for an unchanged head. `dogfood_battery` cites `6345380964`'s VERDICT line, pinned to the same head. `api_writes` lists this round's two relay strokes.
3. ⛔ No MCP write of any kind in this round: one refuses the new report too, and a third round escalates (「最多 2 轮,第三次升级」).

## What the seat does

- On the fresh report: review per `review-checklist.md` against GitHub, ACCEPT with `## 席位核对` on PR #25243 naming the refused report `6343835289`, the superseding claim, and this ruling; then land per `landing-operations.md` (relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`).
- Until then the PR stays draft.

## Standing reminder for card threads (an existing rule, not a new one)

A card thread's first act on a card is to clone the repo and reach `scripts/pm/`: the claim is a PM-role write and goes through the relay like every other write. The deny list in `.claude/settings.json` bites only inside a checkout, so a thread that writes before cloning is outside it — which is how this breach happened.

Prior rulings read: mcp_calls,relay,deny,annotated → 9 hits (ADR-0055 §2/§3, ADR-0056 D2/D9, ADR-0088 §3, ADR-0095 D3, ADR-0099 D4, ADR-0139 D3 — term hits on `relay`/`deny`, none on this question; `docs/adr` has no text on MCP writes); thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.
